title: Sweet Dessert Charcuterie Board
seo_title: Dessert Charcuterie Board for 8–12: Chocolate & Fruit Plan
description: A dessert charcuterie board for 8–12: dark, milk and white chocolate, Nutella, caramel, strawberries, raspberries, graham crackers, pretzels and shortbread.
hook: No cheese, no meat: chocolate, fruit and sweets arranged with the same logic as every other board.
why: The chocolate goes from dark to milk to white, bitter to sweet, so each piece tastes like a step up rather than the sweetest one drowning out the rest. Four dips give everyone something to dunk.

Strawberries and raspberries add tartness that keeps it from getting cloying, and salty mini pretzels are the secret weapon against all that sugar. Shortbread and graham crackers are the sturdy dippers.

timeline.what: Break the chocolate; warm the caramel slightly.
Place the dip bowls and chocolate.
Add the fruit, cookies and pretzels; slice the banana last.
Scatter the sprinkles and mint and serve.

faq.q: What goes on a dessert charcuterie board?
faq.a: Dark, milk and white chocolate, chocolate hazelnut spread, caramel, jam, strawberries, raspberries, banana, dried fruit, graham crackers, pretzels, wafers, shortbread, marshmallows and candied pecans.

faq.q: How do you keep banana from browning?
faq.a: Slice it last and toss with a little lemon juice.
About 3 to 4 oz of sweets and fruit per person after dinner.
